newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sime Darby's results hit cyberspace.
newsitem.headline: Sime Darby's results hit cyberspace.

text.p: Sime Darby Bhd of Malaysia will for the first time make its corporate results available on the Internet, the company said in a statement issued on Friday.
It said a summarised version of its results for the year ended June 30, 1996 would be available through its Web Site.
Sime Darby, with interets ranging from plantations to banking, is expected to release its results after 1300 (0500 GMT) on Saturday.
A survey of 31 stockbrokers has forecast its net profit at 611.3 million ringgit ($245.50 million), or 28.4 cents a share, for the year against 569.2 million ringgit a year ago.
The company will continue to fax releases to the media and making hard copies of its results available for analysts at its Kuala Lumpur headquarters.
The Internet announcement will also include summaries of unaudited results for Sime's DMIB Bhd unit, its Tractors Malaysia Holdings Bhd division and its Sime UEP Properties Bhd unit.
The Sime Darby Web Site is at http://www.simenet.com.
